name: verify_patient
description: Verify the patient's identity using their full name and date of birth. Must succeed before you can view or change appointments.

dob.description: Date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format.

name: search_availability
description: Search for open appointment slots. Provide an appointment type or a provider name, plus a date range. Returns up to 8 of the earliest open slots.

provider_name.description: Provider name or last name, e.g. 'Rao'.

name: list_my_appointments
description: List the verified patient's upcoming appointments.

name: book
description: Book a slot for the verified patient. The slot must come from search_availability. The first call returns a confirmation summary instead of booking: read it to the patient, and once they agree, call book again with the same arguments.

reason.description: Optional short reason for the visit, in the patient's words.

name: reschedule
description: Move one of the verified patient's appointments to a new slot from search_availability. Like book, the first call returns a confirmation summary; call again with the same arguments after the patient agrees.

name: cancel
description: Cancel one of the verified patient's appointments. The first call returns a confirmation summary; call again with the same arguments after the patient agrees.

name: escalate_to_human
description: Hand the conversation to clinic staff, for requests you cannot handle.
